title: Data fills a row, a table or a text, and points take a scale
body: Since acre-4d72e1 a `data` node feeds only `points DATA XCOL YCOL` on a polygon or polyline, in pixels. Filling a `row`, a `table` or a `text` from a data file, and a scale from data units to pixels, were left open. Jack wants these designed after the editing milestone.
close_reason: Landed in 4c45d30. A row takes `cells DATA COL` and a table takes `row DATA COL...`, read by `Table::column_texts` and `Table::texts` in `scene/data.rs`. Data points take `units SX SY` and `origin X Y`, applied in `points` in `scene/build.rs`. A `text` from data was left out: a text holds one string, a column holds one per row, and nothing plain picks the row. The syntax is logged on acre-4518a5.
